title: Hearthstone Battlegrounds Clone With AI
author: Galledan
selftext: For the past month I’ve been working on a Hearthstone Battlegrounds clone in Unity. I used Unity MCP with Cursor and Codex while building it. It supports 1 to 8 players, and empty slots are filled with bots. I’m still pretty new to Unity, so this was mostly a learning project for me. I learned a lot while making it and it was a really good way to get more comfortable with Unity.

comments.author: AustinMHowe
comments.body: As someone who loves battlegrounds this pleases me. Just experimenting or have a spin you’ll be trying out? I tried my own card game system in my projects and didn’t realize how hard it is to balance and be unique.

replies.author: Galledan
replies.body: I was thinking of making a Battlegrounds-inspired PvE game, but I didn’t have any experience building something like that. So my first goal was to replicate the game to understand how it works and how something like it can be built. I haven’t started my own project yet. I’m still trying to figure out the core game loop and overall design. I also expect balancing the game while making it feel unique to be one of the harder parts.

replies.author: AustinMHowe
replies.body:
Not a bad approach at all. Good luck! Let me know if you need game testers, would be happy to!

One thing I had considered before was a plants v zombies + Hearthstone battlegrounds mashup.

replies.author: Galledan
replies.body: Thanks! I’m definitely gonna need that in the future. My first idea was to use historical leaders as Heroes and technologies as Trinkets, but after doing some market research, I decided to move away from that idea. I still think it was a cool concept though. While doing some research I saw a game called "Throne of Bone" it may give you some ideas about your concept.

comments.author: AfternoonMany8117
comments.body: Board is 3d? if so where and how you manage to get this? any workflow info?

replies.author: Galledan
replies.body: It's mostly Canvas and Sprites and Z-axis management. Cards are prefabs made of images. While they move I push them forward on Z and tilt them a little, so a buy or an attack looks like the card is flying. Nothing is 3D modeled

replies.author: AustinMHowe
replies.body: There’s a GitHub project out there that recreated and has tons of assets they (I assume) datamined.

replies.author: Galledan
replies.body: [https://hearthstone.wiki.gg/wiki/Category:Game\_assets](https://hearthstone.wiki.gg/wiki/Category:Game_assets) I got %80-90 of my assets from here. Rest of them cut out by Photoshop or redone by GPT Imagegen
